justification: Standard: switches off a paid product on the live site (pages, APIs, links, sitemap, pricing copy) while keeping already-paid orders working.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database change. Paid shadow orders already in property_reports keep their generate route and shared page.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The tool presented an ADG solar access verdict for neighbouring houses; the stored ADG rows (sepp_adg_requirements 4A-1, 3F-1) show 4A-1 is about a new building's own apartments and 3F is visual privacy.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Uses Next notFound() and HTTP 410 on existing routes; no new routes. New guard test __tests__/shadow-tool-off.test.ts.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any page or component under app/ or components/ links to a shadow route outside the allowlist, a tool page stops calling notFound, the sitemap lists a /shadow URL, next.config redirects to it, or either API stops returning 410.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The guard test was written against the changed tree and passes 6 of 6; it fails on the original main tree because the nav, footer and sitemap all link to /reports/shadow. Full jest 2,233 of 2,233; tsc 0 errors.

functions.name: POST (satellite/shadow)
functions.input: any request to the shadow analysis API
functions.if_none: every HTTP method still answers 410 with the message

functions.name: POST (stripe/checkout/shadow)
functions.input: a checkout request for the shadow report
functions.output: HTTP 410, no Stripe session is created
functions.if_none: every HTTP method still answers 410 with the message

values.name: bundle total
values.source: sum of the six listed report prices on app/pricing/page.tsx (39+39+49+49+49+49)
values.read_at: app/pricing/page.tsx lines 98-103 (the six report prices) and lines 255 and 368 (the bundle copy)
values.if_missing: if a report price changes, the bundle copy must be recomputed from the listed prices by hand

break_it.scenario: A customer who already paid opens the report link in their email.
break_it.what_happens: If the shared page were switched off they would lose what they paid for.
break_it.how: /reports/shadow/{id} page, generate route and webhook branch are kept

break_it.scenario: A search engine or old link visits /shadow/{council}.
break_it.what_happens: It must not show the tool or its verdict.
break_it.how: notFound() and no static params; sitemap entries removed

break_it.scenario: Someone starts a new shadow purchase from a cached page.
break_it.what_happens: They must not be charged for a switched-off product.
break_it.how: checkout route answers 410 before creating a Stripe session

break_it.scenario: The intelligence brief still shows its shadow section.
break_it.what_happens: The brief may still carry the ADG wording.
break_it.how: follow-up PR; not linked from the tool

post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy, /reports/shadow and /shadow/parramatta return 404 and /api/satellite/shadow returns 410.
